03 / HOW I THINKTHE PROCESS BEHIND THE OUTCOME.

Good things
take shape.

001Start with a question.+

What matters here? Who is it for? Before making anything, I make room to understand what it needs to do.

002Find the essential.+

Explore a few directions, notice what feels right, and give the strongest idea a clear foundation. Leave room for a happy accident.

003Care about the small things.+

The rhythm, the spacing, the way something responds. Keep refining until the details feel like they belong together.
